_description: ULTRA_AGGRESSIVE_5Y risk profile — 5-year horizon, maximise growth
_WARNING: This profile significantly relaxes risk limits. Use ONLY with a 5-year+ time horizon and full loss tolerance.

dynamic_limits._description: P1-1D: Dynamic hard limits. Adjusts leverage/gross/single-asset caps by regime, volatility, confidence. Absolute caps are never exceeded.

existence_fuse._description: Relaxed existence fuse for 5-year horizon. Wider thresholds + auto-recovery after 72h cooldown.

tranche._description: Accelerated pyramiding: bigger T1, faster escalation, relaxed gates

cascade_permissions._description: More permissive tranche gating during liquidation cascades. EXHAUSTING stays locked (hard safety).

weekend_manager._description: Relaxed weekend constraints: no forced reduction, higher exposure caps. Hard vetoes (data stale, exchange disconnect, correlation crisis) still apply.

execution._description: Maker cancel-replace (chase) for post-only limit orders. Improves fill rate without taker fallback.

passive_aggressive._description: P2-03: PA executor ACTIVE mode. Drives order type and price improvement based on VPIN/urgency/toxicity. Coordinates with P2-01 maker reprice and P2-02 timing engine.

timing_engine._description: Fee-tier-aware execution timing. Free tier (<$10K/mo): taker is free, allow aggressive at lower urgency. Post-free-tier: maker 16bps vs taker 26bps, restrict taker to high urgency only.

auto_recovery._description: Cautious auto-recovery from non-drawdown HALT reasons. DRAWDOWN_HALT never auto-recovers. Requires observation period + condition checks before resuming.

allocation._description: P4-01: Dynamic concentration. Concentrates exposure on highest-scoring asset when conviction is high.

profit_max._description: P1-2B: FalseBreakout SCALE instead of VETO. Halves exposure instead of blocking trade entirely.

alpha_gate._description: P1-2A: Staged min alpha floor. Lowers the minimum alpha threshold over time. EV gate (friction * multiplier) still applies as stricter constraint in post-free-tier.

confidence_gate._description: P1-2C: Staged confidence floor + min aligned agents. Lowers the minimum confidence and alignment thresholds for ULTRA. HIGH_RISK keeps 0.65/5 defaults.

gambler._description: P4-02: GamblerSizing — heavy-bet mode for OPPORTUNITY windows with strong regimes. Boosts target_exposure up to max_bet_pct_nav. Risk layer (RiskGovernor/LeverageGuard/P0) still vetoes after. In-memory cooldown resets on restart.

short_control._description: P5-01: Relaxed short constraints for ULTRA. Allows shorts in bull regimes, raises max short exposure. Squeeze protection + funding extreme protection preserved. Runs AFTER P0/V6 short blocks — overrides regime-only blocks, keeps safety blocks.
